title: Finite Boolean circuit
statement: For a natural number $n$, a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits consists of a finite number of gates arranged in an order, with each gate either reading an input bit, giving a Boolean constant, negating an earlier gate, or taking the conjunction or disjunction of two earlier gates. One gate is distinguished as the output.
hypotheses_covered: A finite ordered list of gates, each depending only on input bits or earlier gates
